non_blocking_findings.detail: under simultaneous double-invocation, a loser that passed preflight before the winner's attempt-start follows the committed exception path and writes terminal.json (consumed_reads 0) into the winner's live attempt root; if the winner later crashes mid-read the bound terminalizer is blocked by ATTEMPT_ALREADY_TERMINAL while durable receipts hold the true count (demonstrated: bogus terminal consumed 0 versus 5 receipts)
non_blocking_findings.required_handling: runbook must mandate exactly one invocation from one terminal; on any terminal-versus-receipt inconsistency, adjudicate from durable receipts plus proven retained payloads (the contract's declared ledger unit) before banking; next executor generation must guard terminalize when start never succeeded for that process
non_blocking_findings.title: RACE_LOSER_TERMINAL_POLLUTION
